answer: I would stop farms with Licensed butcher cut log with butchers confirmation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 629 pays 10693 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the canyon here is verification, the wharf of cost is what stops the farm, and the willow of the record keeps every claim checkable. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
